n5561a9803b.headline: Metlen Hits €5.1B Revenue in 9M 2025
n5561a9803b.summary: Greek group Metlen reported nine-month 2025 revenue of €5.115 billion, up 22%. Growth was driven by energy and strategic projects across renewables, infrastructure and metallurgy.
n5561a9803b.why: Metlen is a Greek industrial group active in energy, metals and infrastructure, so its results offer a read on Southern European energy and construction demand.

nc7761c7c9e.headline: Ruto: Kenya, Qatar to deepen investment ties in Agriculture, Infrastructure and Finance
nc7761c7c9e.summary: Kenya and Qatar have agreed to expand their partnership through new investments in agriculture, infrastructure and finance. The plan was reported by WardheerNews.
nc7761c7c9e.why: Bilateral investment agreements shape capital flows into African infrastructure and agriculture and signal Gulf sovereign interest in East Africa.

ne8929769f6.headline: Indian IT firm Mphasis counts on banks to power revenue growth, CEO says | Company Business News
ne8929769f6.summary: Indian IT services firm Mphasis expects banks to power its revenue growth, according to its CEO. The comments were reported by Mint.
ne8929769f6.why: Mphasis is an Indian IT services provider with a large banking and financial services client base, so its sector exposure influences Indian IT stocks.

n3d215cdf71.headline: President Mahama must do this for his late father - Manasseh Azure writes amid rice glut
n3d215cdf71.summary: Ghanaian rice and maize farmers face losses from cheap imports amid a rice glut. Journalist Manasseh Azure urged President Mahama to back local rice purchases by state institutions.
n3d215cdf71.why: Ghana relies on imported rice, and cheap imports can undercut domestic farmers, affecting food security and the agricultural economy.

n5ebb80d5a6.headline: Fintech acquisitions boost Lesaka’s revenue
n5ebb80d5a6.summary: Fintech group Lesaka delivered robust first-quarter growth, driven by its consumer, merchant and enterprise businesses. Acquisitions contributed to the revenue increase, according to ITWeb.
n5ebb80d5a6.why: Lesaka is a South African fintech group serving consumers and merchants across the country, and its results indicate growth in African digital payments.

n8b0aa706c3.headline: Construction sector records surprise steep fall in activity ahead of Budget
n8b0aa706c3.summary: The S&P Global UK construction PMI fell to 44.1 in October from 46.2 in September, its lowest reading in over five years. The decline came ahead of the Budget.
n8b0aa706c3.why: The construction PMI is a monthly survey of purchasing managers that signals activity in the UK building sector and offers an early read on the wider economy.

nd3194dcd1e.headline: The UN's COP30 climate summit begins, without the US
nd3194dcd1e.summary: Heads of state have gathered for the UN COP30 climate talks, but leaders from the United States are absent. The summit is taking place in Brazil.
nd3194dcd1e.why: UN climate summits set the international framework for emissions targets and climate finance, which shape long-term energy and industrial investment.

n68ffcd7e58.headline: ProQR Announces Third Quarter 2025 Operating and Financial Results
n68ffcd7e58.summary: ProQR has announced its third quarter 2025 operating and financial results. The company also reported receiving CTA authorization for a Phase 1 trial of its lead program AX-0810, targeting NTCP for cholestatic disease.
n68ffcd7e58.why: ProQR is a Dutch biotechnology company developing RNA-based medicines, so clinical milestones and quarterly results drive its valuation.

n02fe3cf540.headline: Athens Stock Exchange Falls 0.70% to 2,000.44 Points
n02fe3cf540.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange fell 0.70% to 2,000.44 points amid weak European trends. Metlen is exiting the MSCI Standard Index.
n02fe3cf540.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market, and its benchmark tracks the country's largest listed companies. Metlen is a large Greek industrial group.

nb5bbbfe345.headline: MAN backs 15% petrol, diesel import tariff  |
nb5bbbfe345.summary: Nigeria's Manufacturers Association of Nigeria, through its Director-General Segun Ajayi-Kadir, backs a 15% tariff on petrol and diesel imports, according to a statement in Lagos.
nb5bbbfe345.why: Import tariffs on fuel affect domestic refining economics, pump prices and the trade balance of oil-importing economies such as Nigeria.

n65b15469fc.headline: Binance, Buenos Aires to Encourage Sensible Crypto Adoption—But What About Meme Coins?
n65b15469fc.summary: The Buenos Aires government and Binance are working together to get Argentinians using digital assets safely, according to a report that also questions meme coin risks.
n65b15469fc.why: Binance is one of the largest global cryptocurrency exchanges, and government partnerships with exchanges shape retail access and regulatory treatment of digital assets.

n2baf20ea5a.headline: AbbVie Just Raised Its Dividend by 5.5%. Should You Buy ABBV Stock Here?
n2baf20ea5a.summary: AbbVie raised its dividend by 5.5%, lifting the quarterly payout to $1.73 per share starting February 2026. The company cited growth from drugs including Skyrizi and Rinvoq.
n2baf20ea5a.why: AbbVie is a large US pharmaceutical company known for immunology drugs such as Humira's successors Skyrizi and Rinvoq, and its dividend policy is closely watched by income investors.

impacts.name: AbbVie
impacts.why: The company itself announced the dividend increase to its shareholders.

n3096027214.headline: HMRC pension change looming in budget
n3096027214.summary: Ahead of the autumn Budget on 26 November, speculation suggests pensions could be targeted to help cut a £22 billion funding gap. The article does not confirm any decision.
n3096027214.why: Changes to pension taxation affect household savings, pension fund flows and the public finances that the UK Treasury manages through the Budget.

n247fbba5ba.headline: Public Reassured as KeNHA Explains Status of Nairobi–Nakuru–Mau Summit Project
n247fbba5ba.summary: The Kenya National Highways Authority said no tender has been awarded for the Nairobi–Nakuru–Mau Summit and Rironi–Maai Mahiu–Naivasha road projects, only negotiations with a preferred bidder.
n247fbba5ba.why: Public-private partnership road projects involve large infrastructure spending and private financing, affecting contractors, lenders and government budgets.

nd6e58cf213.headline: 'I did this for the world': Delusional Donald Trump claims his insane tariffs saved the 'entire world' from a depression
nd6e58cf213.summary: Donald Trump claimed his tariffs saved the entire world from a depression during a Supreme Court hearing. The remarks were made as the court considered the tariff dispute.
nd6e58cf213.why: Tariff policy affects trade flows, import costs and corporate margins, and court rulings on tariff authority can reshape trade policy.

na1e268cdb8.headline: Aeromexico shares edge higher in NYSE debut
na1e268cdb8.summary: Shares of Grupo Aeromexico rose 0.84% in their New York Stock Exchange debut on Thursday. The listing valued Mexico's largest airline at nearly $2.8 billion.
na1e268cdb8.why: Grupo Aeromexico is Mexico's largest airline and a major carrier in Latin America. Its US listing gives international investors direct access to the company.

n8a68597ab4.headline: Tribunal Overturns Rs. 40 Million Penalty Against Al-Ghazi Tractors
n8a68597ab4.summary: The Competition Appellate Tribunal overturned an order by the Competition Commission of Pakistan that imposed a Rs. 40 million penalty on Al-Ghazi Tractors.
n8a68597ab4.why: Al-Ghazi Tractors is a Pakistani tractor manufacturer, and competition penalties affect its financial results and the regulatory climate for the sector.

n38f340c0ee.headline: Ex-senator takes scalpel to spending in debut budget
n38f340c0ee.summary: The state budget will right-size the public service and tighten discretionary government spending, according to the article, which describes a budget weighed down by pressures.
n38f340c0ee.why: State budgets set public spending and staffing levels, which affect regional economic activity and government borrowing needs.

nf52984623e.headline: Sainsbury’s issues desperate plea to Rachel Reeves ahead of Autumn Budget
nf52984623e.summary: The chief executive of Sainsbury's urged Chancellor Rachel Reeves not to fuel inflation with tax rises on retailers and their suppliers. The plea comes ahead of the Autumn Budget.
nf52984623e.why: Sainsbury's is one of the UK's largest supermarket chains, and budget tax decisions affect retail costs and prices. Investors watch these measures for their impact on margins.

n012bf6b694.headline: Ovintiv Q3 Earnings Surpass Estimates, Revenues Decline Y/Y
n012bf6b694.summary: Ovintiv's third-quarter profit topped estimates as stronger gas prices and production offset weaker oil revenues and margins. Revenue declined year on year.
n012bf6b694.why: Ovintiv is a North American oil and natural gas producer, so its results reflect both commodity prices and drilling output.

ndb96c1d1d3.headline: Toyota hikes profit forecasts
ndb96c1d1d3.summary: Toyota has raised its full-year profit forecast despite the challenging landscape created by US tariffs. The company emphasised productivity improvements, though its shares fell after the announcement.
ndb96c1d1d3.why: Toyota is the world's largest carmaker by volume, and its profit outlook is closely watched as a read on global auto demand and trade conditions.
ndb96c1d1d3.why_moved: Toyota's raised forecast came despite US tariff pressure, and its shares fell after the announcement.

nf89d93e32d.headline: Mettler-Toledo's (NYSE:MTD) Q3 Sales Beat Estimates
nf89d93e32d.summary: Mettler-Toledo reported third-quarter sales above analyst estimates, according to the headline of its NYSE-listed results report.
nf89d93e32d.why: Mettler-Toledo makes precision weighing and laboratory instruments sold to pharmaceutical, chemical and food industries. Its quarterly sales are a read-through for demand in laboratory and industrial equipment.

n5cd6dd8485.headline: Mixed Sentiment In World Markets
n5cd6dd8485.summary: Market sentiment is dominated by corporate earnings, worries about tech valuations and concerns about the longest-ever shutdown of the US government.
n5cd6dd8485.why: Earnings and valuation concerns drive equity market direction, while government shutdowns can delay US economic data.

n5633a3e607.headline: Ontario predicts grim economic outlook with rising unemployment and lower job creation  | Globalnews.ca
n5633a3e607.summary: Ontario's finance minister is set to unveil a fiscal update in the legislature, parts of which have already been published. The outlook points to rising unemployment and lower job creation.
n5633a3e607.why: Ontario is Canada's most populous province and largest economy, so its fiscal outlook affects provincial borrowing and the wider Canadian economy.

nf2e1738972.headline: What Did Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley CEOs Say to Spook the Market?
nf2e1738972.summary: The chief executives of Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley warned of a correction of 10% or more in the near term. Their remarks unsettled the market.
nf2e1738972.why: Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are leading Wall Street investment banks, so their chief executives' market outlooks are closely watched by investors.
nf2e1738972.why_moved: Warnings from the CEOs of Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley about a near-term correction of 10% or more unsettled investors.

n90deb76011.headline: 'Substantial risk' gas could delay clean energy shift
n90deb76011.summary: Australia has been warned that its gas exports risk slowing the global energy transition. The warning came weeks after a government decision the article references.
n90deb76011.why: Australia is one of the world's largest liquefied natural gas exporters, so its export policy affects global gas supply and energy-transition timelines.

nbed2a4db38.headline: TENAZ ENERGY CORP. ANNOUNCES Q3 2025 RESULTS
nbed2a4db38.summary: Tenaz Energy Corp., listed on the TSX as TNZ, announced financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2025. The results were released from Calgary, Alberta.
nbed2a4db38.why: Tenaz is a Canadian oil and gas producer, and its quarterly results show revenue, production and cash flow trends for investors.

n4f4cc733b3.headline: More than a third of STEM professionals consider moving abroad
n4f4cc733b3.summary: The Netherlands is preparing a distance-based tolling system for heavy goods vehicles over 3.5 metric tons, scheduled to start in July 2026. The system uses GNSS satellite positioning.
n4f4cc733b3.why: Road tolls raise haulage costs for freight operators, and changes in charging rules can pass through to transport and logistics pricing.

n4bed463183.headline: Sensex, Nifty Crawl Upwards As Investors Await RBI’s Key Interest Rate Decision
n4bed463183.summary: Indian equity markets opened slightly lower on Friday as investors awaited the Reserve Bank of India's key interest rate decision. The Monetary Policy Committee will announce the repo rate at 10 AM.
n4bed463183.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets the repo rate, which influences borrowing costs, bank lending and equity valuations in India.

n187c0e8067.headline: DPD Ireland's revenues top €200m for the second time
n187c0e8067.summary: DPD Ireland, the country's largest dedicated parcel delivery firm, reported a 14% rise in pre-tax profit to €29.07m, its highest to date. Pre-tax profit was three times pre-Covid levels of €9.6m.
n187c0e8067.why: DPD Ireland is the Irish arm of the French-owned DPD parcel network, and its results offer a read on domestic e-commerce and logistics demand.

n79762e608e.headline: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang softens stance after saying ‘China will win the AI race’
n79762e608e.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang appears to be backtracking on earlier comments that China will win the AI race. The remarks concern the competitive balance in artificial intelligence.
n79762e608e.why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, so its CEO's views on the AI race bear on expectations for chip demand and US-China technology competition.

n4abb1cce92.headline: Why gold prices are soaring
n4abb1cce92.summary: Gold prices are rising as a hedge against unpredictable world events and policy uncertainty tied to President Donald Trump. Investors see momentum in the move.
n4abb1cce92.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset, and its price tends to rise when investors seek protection against political and economic uncertainty.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Safe-haven demand driven by uncertainty pushes gold prices higher.

n4abb1cce92.why_moved: Investors are buying gold as a hedge against unpredictable world events and policy uncertainty linked to President Trump.

n0e538cdeb3.headline: MSCI Adds 14 PSX Companies to Its Indices, Removes 2
n0e538cdeb3.summary: MSCI has added 14 Pakistan-listed companies to its indices and removed two. The changes affect Pakistan Stock Exchange constituents in MSCI's index family.
n0e538cdeb3.why: MSCI is a major index provider, and index inclusion can drive passive fund buying and selling of constituent stocks.

ndcd4bc27d1.headline: Lawmakers Urge Parliamentary Approval for All Foreign Debt Deals
ndcd4bc27d1.summary: Syed Naveed Qamar, chairman of the National Assembly Standing Committee on Finance, has called for all foreign debt agreements to be ratified by Parliament.
ndcd4bc27d1.why: Foreign debt terms shape sovereign borrowing costs and fiscal room, which matter to investors in Pakistani government bonds and the rupee.

n2fd91871c0.headline: Asia Market Open: Bitcoin Reverses Slide, Tracks Global Stocks Higher on Positive US Data
n2fd91871c0.summary: Bitcoin bounced back above $103,000 as risk appetite returned after stronger-than-expected US economic data and a global equity rebound, while a firm dollar capped gains.
n2fd91871c0.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency, and its price often reacts to shifts in global risk sentiment and dollar strength.

n2fd91871c0.why_moved: Stronger-than-expected US economic data lifted risk appetite and global equities, and bitcoin recovered with them. A firm dollar limited the gains.

n3159c6a658.headline: Gamuda, PKNPk signs MOU with Penang water operator on sales of treated water
n3159c6a658.summary: Gamuda and Perbadanan Kemajuan Negeri Perak signed a memorandum of understanding with PBAPP to explore a long-term supply of excess treated water, according to a Bursa Malaysia filing.
n3159c6a658.why: Gamuda is a Malaysian infrastructure and construction group, and water supply contracts are a growing part of its utility-related business.

ne22373a9d5.headline: Spotlight on knife-edge BoE decision
ne22373a9d5.summary: Markets are looking ahead to the Bank of England's Thursday interest rate decision, which had seemed a straightforward hold but is now seen as finely balanced.
ne22373a9d5.why: The Bank of England sets UK interest rates, which feed into sterling, gilt yields and borrowing costs across the UK economy.

n7fe863f3f3.headline: Prime Minister Mark Carney unveiled his first federal budget, here’s what you need to know
n7fe863f3f3.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney has unveiled his government's first federal budget, which aims to invest $1 trillion in building a more self-sufficient economy.
n7fe863f3f3.why: Federal budgets set Canada's spending, deficit and tax path, which shape government bond supply, fiscal outlook and sector demand. Canada's economy is heavily tied to resources and trade.

n154d0c9782.headline: What the 2025 federal budget means for BC: minerals, wood and LNG : My Nelson Now
n154d0c9782.summary: Local coverage outlines what the 2025 federal budget means for British Columbia across minerals, forestry and liquefied natural gas.
n154d0c9782.why: British Columbia's economy depends heavily on resource sectors such as mining, forestry and LNG, so federal policy in these areas affects provincial investment.

nfecb3f528b.headline: Mistras (MG) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
nfecb3f528b.summary: Mistras Group held its third-quarter 2025 earnings call, with management reminding listeners of forward-looking risks described in its filings.
nfecb3f528b.why: Mistras provides testing and inspection services to energy, infrastructure and industrial clients, so its quarterly results reflect demand in those markets.

nebb23c0815.headline: India could generate 11 mn tonnes of solar waste by 2047: Study
nebb23c0815.summary: India is projected to produce 11 million tonnes of solar waste by 2047, requiring 300 recycling facilities and Rs 4,200 crore investment to recover materials.
nebb23c0815.why: The growth of solar energy in India creates sustainability challenges; managing solar waste is important for environmental and economic reasons.

n6fffb4d722.headline: CGIL, assembly in Florence tomorrow, general strike also under consideration - Latest news - Ansa.it
n6fffb4d722.summary: Italian union CGIL holds its delegates assembly in Florence to challenge the budget law, with a possible general strike on the table.
n6fffb4d722.why: Labour actions and budget disputes in Italy can affect public spending plans, government bond sentiment and economic activity.

n3c0c8254ce.summary: More than 156.7 million manats were refunded to consumers under the VAT Refund programme in January to October, according to the State Tax Service.
n3c0c8254ce.why: VAT refund programmes affect consumer spending and tax revenue flows, and are tracked as indicators of retail activity.

n5eeb64a058.headline: If they do not stop adopting the Christmas bonus law, employers will do it
n5eeb64a058.summary: Unions see no reason to cancel the ESS session on the Christmas bonus law. Employers warn that if the law is not stopped, they will act themselves.
n5eeb64a058.why: Year-end bonus rules affect labour costs and payroll planning for companies operating in Slovenia.
